reviews.title: Great budget AIO without sacrificing looks or performance
reviews.comment: Pretty easy install, keeps CPU under 45 celsius under 100% load (i5-13400k), looks great. One of the cheapest 240m AIO's on the market making it great on a budget without giving up much cooling performance compared to more expensive options.
reviews.author: Jo

reviews.title: good value.
reviews.comment: about 10c cooler on my 265kf than peerless assasin for just a few more dollars.

reviews.title: Works well for the price.
reviews.comment: Does the job. Setup was a lil wonky as the instructions aren’t very detailed but I managed to figure it all out. Keeps my 7800x3d below 50 on idle and under 60 on load, so no complaints.

reviews.title: It’s good overall
reviews.comment: The am5 connector is moronic if you have anything it’s motherboard or matx. Like why would they not have a normal bracket and not this cheap thing that just connects to your motherboards in house bracket things. And yes I know this thing I cheap AF which in turn makes this thing fantastic for budget and performance like don’t get me wrong it’s great at cooling and it’s fit is perfect but it’s that stupid connector thing is my only actual gripe.
